title: When Intelligence Becomes Agency: A Theory of Governed, Proactive Agency for Symbiotic AI Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.07741v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Persistent AI assistants are intended to extend human attention, memory, and coordination across changing digital and physical environments. To be truly useful they must do more than just act when asked. They must decide on their own whether a situation warrants behavior at all, when it does and in what mode, whether to act, ask, monitor, defer or deliberately refrain. We call this the activation problem. Research on commitment, appraisal, mixed-initiative interaction and delegation each illuminates part of it, but none ties situated activation to continuing authorization and accountability. This paper develops a conceptual and formal framework for governed proactive agency, organizing behavior across time through perception, intent, affective-conative appraisal, constraint, and feedback. translated_title: 当智能成为能动性：共生AI系统的受治理主动能动性理论
translated_abstract: 持续型AI助手旨在跨不断变化的数字和物理环境来扩展人类的注意力、记忆力和协调能力。要真正有用，它们必须做到的不仅仅是被要求时才行动。它们必须自主判断一种情境是否需要行为、何时需要以及以何种模式进行，是行动、询问、监控、推迟还是刻意克制。我们将此称为“激活问题”。关于承诺、评估、混合主动交互和委托的研究各自阐明了这一问题的某个部分，但没有一项研究将情境化的激活与持续的授权和问责联系起来。本文为受治理的主动能动性开发了一个概念性和形式化框架，通过感知、意图、情感-意志评估、约束和反馈来组织跨时间的行为。该框架区分了自主能动性和委托能动性，并将共生能动性定义为在长期、可撤销的授权下的委托，并伴随持续的耦合……
tldr: 本文提出“激活问题”这一新概念，并构建了受治理主动能动性的概念与形式化框架，将共生能动性定义为长期可撤销授权下的委托行为，从而为持续型AI助手何时以及如何自主行动提供持续的授权与问责机制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "activation problem" and develops a conceptual and formal framework for governed proactive agency, defining symbiotic agency as delegation under a standing, revocable mandate to govern when and how persistent AI assistants should autonomously act with continuing authorization and accountability.
